project_type: fastai deep learning library (nbdev-managed Python package), fork IngridMorstrad/fastai
build_system: nbdev + setuptools. Library modules under fastai/ are normally generated from nbs/*.ipynb notebooks, but this fork also contains hand-authored standalone modules (e.g. fastai/callback/gradient_noise.py) that have NO backing notebook and NO _modidx.py entry.
build_command: pip install "setuptools<72" wheel; pip install --no-build-isolation git+https://github.com/fastai/fastcore.git@master; pip install --no-build-isolation git+https://github.com/fastai/nbdev.git@main; pip install --no-deps -e .
test_command: python -m pytest tests/test_check_env.py -v   (full suite: python -m pytest tests/ -v)
verification_instructions: CI gate (.github/workflows/main.yml, job test-nbdev-sync) runs `python -m nbdev.export` then fails if `git status --porcelain -uno` is non-empty. There is NO pytest job in CI. Green bar == nbdev sync produces zero diff AND the dependency install succeeds. Local verification: install deps as CI does, run `python -m nbdev.export`, confirm `git status --porcelain -uno` is EMPTY, then run pytest.
snapshot_or_generated_files: nbdev regenerates fastai/*.py ONLY for modules with a backing nbs/*.ipynb. Hand-authored modules with no notebook (like fastai/callback/gradient_noise.py) are left untouched. So adding fastai/check_env.py with NO notebook and NO _modidx.py entry produces no sync diff. Regenerate check command: python -m nbdev.export && git status --porcelain -uno (must be empty).
setup_instructions: Python 3.9 locally (CI uses 3.11, min_python=3.9). Network mode COMMON_DEPENDENCIES: pip/git+github installs of fastcore/nbdev/torch should work. torch/fastcore/nbdev are NOT pre-installed.
environment_constraints: COMMON_DEPENDENCIES network. torch, fastcore, nbdev not pre-installed. torch install is heavy; fastai_check_env MUST degrade gracefully when torch/CUDA are not importable (that is its purpose), so its tests must run WITHOUT a GPU and WITHOUT torch by mocking/monkeypatching sys.modules. No GPU available.
contribution_requirements: Do NOT edit FEATURE_REQUESTS.md, CONTRIBUTING.md, or BUGS.md. Follow established fork pattern for added features: standalone module under fastai/ + matching pytest test under tests/, no paired notebook, no _modidx.py entry. Register CLI by appending to console_scripts in settings.ini.
key_patterns: Hand-authored feature module pattern = fastai/callback/gradient_noise.py: module-level docstring, __all__, graceful fallback import of fastai base (try/except), clear docstrings, ValueError on bad input. Test pattern = tests/test_gradient_noise.py: pytest classes (TestXxx), docstring per test, mock objects for fastai internals. conftest.py already inserts repo root + tests dir on sys.path.
relevant_files: settings.ini (console_scripts line to append to; version/min_python/requirements/pip_requirements constraints to validate against)
fastai/distributed.py (nbdev-generated reference; has configure_accelerate console_scripts registration)
directory_structure: fastai/ = library modules (mix of nbdev-generated and hand-authored). nbs/ = source notebooks. tests/ = pytest tests (standalone, not nbdev). settings.ini = nbdev/setuptools config incl console_scripts, requirements, version constraints.
